title: How Going First to Forgive Frees a Godly Man
caption:
Christ didn't wait for an apology before he went to the cross.

He forgave first. Before sorry ever came.

While we were still sinners, Christ died for us (Romans 5:8). Not after we cleaned up. Before.

Stop waiting for the words that may never come. Go first anyway. It costs more than being right, and it's the only version that actually frees you.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #forgiveness #brotherhood
theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
